record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale each Transformer feed-forward residual contribution by 0.8 while leaving attention residuals unchanged. The 0.5 trial's small regression motivates testing gentler attenuation that may retain useful nonlinear context transformations while limiting their distortion. Preserve GELU, block count, widths, normalization, bidirectional attention, embeddings, sequence policy, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Mirror the residual formula in the predictor writer.

+class ScaledFFTransformerEncoderLayer(nn.TransformerEncoderLayer):
+    def forward(self, src, src_mask=None, src_key_padding_mask=None, is_causal=False):
+        x = src
+        if self.norm_first:
+            x = x + self._sa_block(
+                self.norm1(x), src_mask, src_key_padding_mask,
+                is_causal=is_causal,
+            )

+                is_causal=is_causal,
+            ))
+            x = self.norm2(x + 0.8 * self._ff_block(x))

category_rationales.rationale: Scale each feed-forward residual contribution by 0.8 across all four category models while preserving attention residuals and existing GELU sublayers. Explicit forward execution preserves the same residual formula during training and inference. The predictor writer already imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically loads the updated architecture with unchanged checkpoint shapes.
